card.damaged: Damaged (level {{level}}) — works at half speed. Recovers in {{remaining}}.
card.produces: Produces {{resource}} — everything made goes to storage on its own every minute.
card.locked: Unlocks when the Town Hall reaches level {{level}}.

hospital.title: Hospital
hospital.empty: No wounded — they'll show up here after battles.

messHall.meal: The settlement eats {{amount}} meat per hour — the more building levels, the more. It's charged every 10 minutes.
messHall.hint: Keep the Farm growing: run out of meat and the village starves, cutting production of everything but meat by a quarter.

hunger.village: The settlement is short of meat. The Mess Hall couldn't feed everyone: defense is a fifth weaker and production of everything but meat drops by a quarter. Upgrade the Farm — the hunger ends at the next meal (within 10 min) once there's enough meat.
hunger.beasts: The beasts are short of fodder. While they're hungry, passives won't activate; active ones play out. The Fishing Hut makes fodder — the beasts eat their fill at the next meal (within 10 min).

damage.list: Damaged: {{buildings}}. Damaged buildings produce at half speed, and the walls protect less.
damage.lastChance: One more defeat before a full recovery — and the settlement will be evicted.
damage.left: {{count}} more defeats without a full recovery until eviction.

page.dragHint: Drag a building to a free spot inside the wall
